prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. The attached local image is a style reference only, not an edit target. Match its very low-resolution pixel art, muted ivory, antique gold, dark brown leading, desaturated blue and burgundy glass. New original composition. Front-facing flat orthographic sprite, dark stone arched border, full window visible. Actual intended sprite canvas is 32 pixels wide by 70 pixels tall: restrict detail to a strict 32x70 logical pixel grid, nearest-neighbor hard square pixels, no antialiasing, no soft gradients. Center exactly one narrow window in a portrait canvas with 32:70 aspect ratio; frame fills canvas width and height, tiny transparent corners around arch only. Genuine transparent background, no scenery, no lettering, no shadow outside window. Output only the sprite.
